This inventory contains commands marked as implemented in the runtime action manifest. Audacity-derived entries are reviewed against Audacity 4.0.0 at [`4c177d436e48`](https://github.com/audacity/audacity/tree/4c177d436e48c1d20f231eada44035593cb26292/src). Local entries are identified separately.

Local application-menu entries come from the reviewed menu reference registry.

Product availability follows each product profile’s command filters and each local menu entry’s declared product list. “—” means that no default shortcut is assigned; it does not mean the command is unavailable.
